description: A claimed PASS cannot coexist with failed or missing check exits
prompt: Harden harness/verdict.py. It must accept a PASS artifact only when the verdict is PASS, checks are non-empty, and every check has an explicit integer exit_code of zero. Fail closed for missing fields, failed checks, and empty check lists.

fake.good_response: PASS is now derived from a non-empty set of explicit zero exit codes.
fake.bad_response: Required the checks field to exist.
